# Issue #7: touching intervals are not merged

`merge_intervals([(1, 3), (3, 5)])` returns `[(1, 3), (3, 5)]` but the documented
behaviour is that closed intervals sharing an endpoint merge into `[(1, 5)]`.
Unsorted input must also be handled. Fix `ranges/merge.py`.

arguments.summary: Fixed `ranges/merge.py` in two ways: (1) changed the merge condition from `start < last_end` to `start <= last_end` so that closed intervals sharing an endpoint (e.g. (1,3) and (3,5)) merge into (1,5), and (2) iterate over `sorted(intervals)` so unsorted input is handled correctly. The test suite passes and manual checks (unsorted, overlapping, empty, single interval) all behave as documented.
